scenes.title: Same cold email. One prompt later.
Watch it **change**
scenes.before: Hi, I run a marketing agency and wanted to see if you'd be interested in our services. We have worked with many clients. Let me know if you want to chat.
scenes.after: Hi Dana, I noticed your last three newsletters all link to the same page. A small change to the first line could help each one earn its click. I rewrote one as an example. Want me to send it?

caption:
Same cold email, before and after one prompt. ✍️

The first one talks about us. The second one talks about her, and ends with an easy question.

The prompt is in AI for Freelancers, a 50-prompt PDF for pitching, pricing, and getting paid.

💬 Comment FREELANCE and I'll DM you the link.

The example is illustrative. Results vary.
